answer: The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The bridge assignment is published and harbor records each panel. Shards are assigned from the nectar graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1300 identities would post 625 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
